preconditions.name: zworld_world_encoder_trained
preconditions.description: P0 warmup moved at least one split_encoder.world_encoder tensor, i.e. z_world is a prediction-trained encoder rather than a frozen random projection
preconditions.control: the P0 warmup itself, on the arm's own training env at the arm's own p0 episode count -- the phase whose stated job is to train the world model

preconditions.name: zworld_encodes_exogenous_change
preconditions.description: bare ||z_obs - z_prev|| AUROC for hazard-moved vs not, STAY stratum, measured pre- AND post-shift
preconditions.control: positive control -- agent cannot have caused the change

preconditions.name: move_ok_confound_absent
preconditions.description: bare ||z_obs - z_prev|| AUROC in MOVE_OK near chance, pre- AND post-shift (the shift never touches raw change magnitude by construction -- this confirms it empirically too)

preconditions.name: causal_class_events_sufficient
preconditions.description: min(n_drift, n_no_drift) in the POST-shift held-out MOVE_OK stratum (the verdict-scoring set)
preconditions.control: the exact precondition V3-EXQ-783 failed on

preconditions.name: e2world_action_pathway_live
preconditions.description: mean ||f(z,a_i) - f(z,a_j)|| AT INITIALISATION (PRE_BASE arm only -- POST arms start from PRE_BASE's already-live weights)

preconditions.name: action_map_genuinely_rewired
preconditions.description: count of the 4 movement actions whose post-shift displacement differs from its pre-shift (canonical) displacement
preconditions.control: sanity check that the single 4-cycle rotation is not an accidental no-op -- guaranteed by construction (no fixed points), verified per seed

preconditions.name: surface_statistics_preserved
preconditions.description: max absolute deviation between pre- and post-shift STAY / MOVE_OK / MOVE_BLOCKED / drift-event fractions
preconditions.control: the load-bearing design claim -- a permutation of interchangeable movement actions under a uniformly-random policy holds these marginals fixed in expectation; this measures the finite-sample deviation

preconditions.name: pre_base_in_distribution_signature
preconditions.description: PRE_BASE (in-distribution) comparator must itself be informative: mean(auroc_move_ok_pre) - 0.5 >= max(0.050, sd) AND mean(auroc_move_ok_pre - auroc_bare_move_ok_pre) >= max(0.050, sd)
preconditions.control: mirrors 995's own C1+C2 combined, on PRE_BASE only -- a failing in-distribution fit makes any post-shift D1/D2 FAIL uninterpretable (is it the shift, or was PRE_BASE never a real signature?)

preconditions.name: shift_degrades_frozen_forward_fit
preconditions.description: frozen model's post-shift held-out forward MSE minus its own PRE_BASE held-out forward MSE (same weights) -- must be positive in every seed, confirming the action-map rewiring actually degraded the frozen model's predictions (the manipulation reached the DV) rather than being invisible to it

preconditions.name: readapt_does_not_regress_frozen_fit
preconditions.description: frozen held-out forward MSE minus readapt's held-out forward MSE (same held-out post-shift data), minus max(1e-05, 5% of the shift-induced degradation frozen_mse-pre_mse) -- must be positive in every seed, i.e. the 120-optimizer-step readapt pass measurably reduced forward error, scaled to how much there was to recover, not merely a non-negative (possibly zero) delta
preconditions.control: readapt-budget non-vacuity check, not a full positive control (no scratch-model / unshifted-env ceiling -- documented residual limitation, see module docstring)
